يحتجموا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِمُوا (yaḥtajimū) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# يُحْتَجَمُوا (yuḥtajamū) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
